items.title: New episode on EDPS on Air is out!
items.description: New episode on EDPS on Air is out! “Attackers don't need to beat the firewall, they just need to catch the right person, on the wrong day, to open the door. But that’s exactly why focusing on people provides the best defence.” 🎯 Cyberattacks are often thought of as a hacker finding a technical flaw in the system. But in Europe, the front door to 60% of cyber intrusions is a human moment: 🖱️ a click on a phishing link, or 📞 a voice that sounds familiar. 📊 So far this year, EU institutions have reported 115 personal data breaches to us. About half of those notifications were cyberattacks, and even then, it’s often a person who opens the door. For European Cybersecurity Month # ECSM , our Technology and Security Officer Konstantina Vemou, PhD joins # EDPSonAir to explain how AI is making phishing harder to spot, which warning signs to look for, and why a once-a-year e-learning module is no longer enough. She also talks about🛡️PATRICIA and🛡️ ARETE, the exercises we’ve developed to help EU institutions manage a breach and assess the risk to the people affected. 🎧 Listen here: https:// lnkd.in/eD6MDg9H
